data.name: Sich
data.detailed_description:
Become a warrior in a world forged by the brutal struggles of 17th-century Europe. Sich is an intense, multiplayer tactical action game where you plunge into massive, team-based battles. Choose your side—align with the fierce Cossacks or the disciplined Polish forces—and test your mettle in high-stakes melee and firearm combat featuring over 100 players per server. 

Step into a unforgiving land shaped by war, plague, and historic conflict. Battle across diverse, beautifully realized environments inspired by the historic uprisings of Bohdan Khmelnytsky’s era. From heavily fortified Cossack villages and grand noble estates to the wild, sweeping steppes along the Dnipro River and the treacherous shores of the Black Sea, every map tells a story of survival. 

Master a massive arsenal of era-authentic weaponry, including muskets, pistols, bows, sabres, broadswords, spears, maces, war hammers, and devastating field cannons. 

Sich features a directional combat system where your mouse movements dictate every swing, thrust, and block. There is no button-mashing here—every encounter with an enemy player feels like a tense, highly personal duel where skill is the only thing keeping you alive. 

The world of Sich is constantly expanding. Here is what you can look forward to in future updates: 

  • Proximity & Team Voice Chat: Coordinate strategies with your squad or taunt your enemies in the heat of battle. 

  • Deep Character Customization: Forge your unique warrior with era-appropriate gear and cosmetic options. 

  • Mounts & Transport: Take to the battlefield on horseback to flank your enemies. 

  • New Nations: Expand the conflict with the arrival of new historical factions. 

  • Army Command: Rise through the ranks and command your army to turn the tide of war. 

  • Open-World Survival Mode: Face the elements, hunger, and hostile factions in a brutal open world. 

  • Crafting & Building: Gather resources to construct fortifications and craft essential wartime gear.

data.short_description: Experience 100+ player tactical battle in a 17th-century Eastern Europe historical shooter. Master directional melee, authentic period firearms and heavy artillery. Fight for survival across war-torn steppes and fortified villages. Form a squad, stand your ground, and experience early modern warfare
